name: Jadar, Ghoulcaller of Nephalia
oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, if you control no creatures with decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed. (It can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat.)
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if you control no creatures with decayed, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed.

needs.what: the decayed keyword (702.147): the creature can't block, and when it attacks, its controller sacrifices it at end of combat; it must also be readable by a selector's `keywords` filter so the intervening-if "you control no creatures with decayed" can be an `exists` check
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `decayed` is not in the packet's `keywords` list, so neither the token nor the condition filter `keywords: ["decayed"]` can be written; approximating it with a can't-block static plus an attack trigger would not be matched by the "creatures with decayed" condition

needs.what: a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` has `zombie_2_2_b` (a plain 2/2 black Zombie with no decayed); using it would make a token that can block and is never sacrificed, and it would never satisfy the condition, so Jadar would make one every end step
